title: Compile-Time Kitchen (constexpr)

links.title: Compiler Explorer (see that the result is a constant)

hints: A constexpr function is ordinary code: loops, local variables and if are all allowed since C++14.
fib: iterate with two long long variables. The naive recursion fib(n-1) + fib(n-2) takes billions of steps for n = 50 and the compiler gives up ('constexpr evaluation operation count exceeds limit').
is_prime: trial division while d * d <= n; do the multiplication in long long, because overflow inside a constant expression is a compile ERROR, not silent UB.
first_primes<N>: declare std::array<int, N> out{}; and fill it with a counter while walking 2, 3, 4, ...
